cards.descriptionZh: 每当你给予一个敌人负面状态时，使其受到{SleightOfFleshPower:diff()}点伤害。

cards.name: Snap
cards.title: Snap
cards.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Add [gold]Retain[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh:
[gold]奥斯提[/gold]造成{OstyDamage:diff()}点伤害。
给[gold]手牌[/gold]中的一张牌添加[gold]保留[/gold]。

cards.name: SoulStorm
cards.title: Soul Storm
cards.description: Deal {CalculationBase:diff()} damage. Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Soul[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh: 造成 {CalculationBase:diff()} 点伤害。你[gold]消耗牌堆[/gold]中每有一张[gold]灵魂[/gold],额外造成 {ExtraDamage:diff()} 点伤害。
dynamicVars: new CalculatedDamageVar(ValueProp.Move).WithMultiplier((CardModel card, Creature? _) => card.Owner.PlayerCombatState?.ExhaustPile.Cards.Count((CardModel c) => c is Soul) ?? 0)

cards.name: Sow
cards.title: Sow
cards.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
cards.descriptionZh: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。

cards.name: SpiritOfAsh
cards.title: Spirit of Ash
cards.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card, gain {BlockOnExhaust:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh: 每当你打出一张[gold]虚无[/gold]牌时，获得{BlockOnExhaust:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

cards.name: Spur
cards.title: Spur
cards.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Osty[/gold] heals {Heal:diff()} HP.
cards.descriptionZh:
[gold]召唤[/gold]{Summon:diff()}。
[gold]奥斯提[/gold]回复{Heal:diff()}点生命。

cards.name: Squeeze
cards.title: Squeeze
cards.description: Osty deals {CalculationBase:diff()} damage. Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card with [gold]Osty Attack[/gold] in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh: Osty 造成 {CalculationBase:diff()} 点伤害。你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中每有一张拥有[gold]Osty 攻击[/gold]的牌,额外造成 {ExtraDamage:diff()} 点伤害。
dynamicVars: new CalculatedDamageVar(ValueProp.Move).FromOsty().WithMultiplier((CardModel card, Creature? _) => card.Owner.PlayerCombatState.AllCards.Count((CardModel c) => c.Tags.Contains(CardTag.OstyAttack) && c != card))
